summary: A ticketed ($31), monthly dinner meetup run by Ermantourage (by ADDVentures), a commercial event-production company operating the same 'Foodies + New Friends' format across 9+ cities nationwide (Hendersonville, Roseville, Fayetteville, Charlottesville, Los Angeles, etc.), each with rotating themed editions (Giving Back, Single Friends, 1-on-1). Attendees sign up individually per dinner for small tables of 4-6 to 12-24 strangers; there is no fixed membership, roster, or evidence of the same people returning across sessions in Asheville. The recurrence is the company's franchise-style event product, not a persistent local community.

evidence.note: Ticketed at $31, organizer is 'Ermantourage NYC' (an out-of-town event company), and each listing's description is generic marketing copy identical across the series, not references to a specific returning membership.
6 Asheville dates span May-Oct 2026 at 'Restaurant of the Month' / Chorizo on Page Avenue, framed as themed one-off editions rather than sessions of an ongoing club.

The company's own site describes the format as strangers signing up individually for capped small-group dinners rotating across 9+ cities, explicitly a booking model rather than a fixed-membership group.

Ermantourage NYC runs many parallel event brands (Dinner with Entrepreneurs, Dinner with Strangers, Foodies + New Friends) across numerous cities, confirming it is a multi-city commercial event producer, not an Asheville-based community.

Search turned up near-identical 'Foodies + New Friends' listings for Hendersonville, Roseville, Summerville, Fayetteville, Charlottesville, and Los Angeles, all from the same organizer with the same $31 pricing pattern, reinforcing that Asheville is just one franchise stop rather than a standalone group.
